provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled closed reversible label exchange R<->S, with equal first-order one-direction rate k on both arrows. Total amount R+S is constant. dR/dt=-k*R+k*S, dS/dt=k*R-k*S; ee=(R-S)/(R+S). No degradation, equilibrium energy bias or continued input.
target: Infer the common one-direction k using the complete ee observations and test one exponential across all times. Report the half-life of ee, not the half-life of a molecule before its first transition. Reconstruct normalized R/S fractions at the last time.
scope: Conditional symmetry-exchange kinetics of benign labels, no reaction conditions, stereochemical manipulation or actual molecular racemization forecast.
